# Feature: Product screen (Produkte)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-11-01 -->

## Intent
Company Product area with table/card toggle, create/edit modal (Beschreibung · Kalkulation · Persona Journey), CMB-style calc stored on Product, persona links + journey canvas. Empty start; soft-archive. CMB tool entry removed from Tools.

## Preconditions
- User authenticated with product/catalog/cmb tab entitlement
- Company exists; editor+ for writes

## Happy Path
- [ ] Open Produkt → empty state + „+ Produkt“
- [ ] Create product (name+description+market required) → appears in table and cards
- [ ] Toggle Tabelle | Karten
- [ ] Open card → edit modal; Speichern persists
- [ ] Kalkulation: price + 5 cost depts; Nettoerlös updates
- [ ] Persona Journey: link personas; Customer Journey canvas saves nodes/edges
- [ ] Archive + filter Aktiv | Archiv
- [ ] Tools has no CostMyBusiness entry; /tools/cmb redirects to product

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Viewer cannot create/update
- [ ] Invalid create (missing required) blocked
- [ ] Cover image optional; initials fallback
- [ ] Image >2MB rejected

## Regression
- [ ] Marketing funnel still works
- [ ] Personas list under Marketing still loads

## Assumptions
- Cost positions stored as JSON on product; calc uses finance-calc resolveNetRevenue
- Journey canvas is product-scoped JSON (nodes/edges), not full Legacy feature parity beyond save/load/edit
